notes: Styling system: styles.css (minified, one line) declares type/spacing/radius/duration tokens in :root; colour tokens --c-* are injected at run time by app.js he()/B() (app.js col 445-1568) for light and dark. No component library; app.js is a minified one-line bundle, so every app.js location is line 1 with a 1-based column and a distinguishing snippet in method. Locations found by text search; no data-insp-path. Key root causes: injected '.slot:focus{outline:0}' (col 5438); 'order:-1' on few slots (col 6099); p() 360px grid override (col 5492); te() ignores stored date/slot (col 5208); '.field{display:flex}' defeats [hidden] on #permit-wrap (styles.css col 2389), explaining F-0046. F-0020: source does carry aria-current="step" on the current li in all three step lists, so the 'not exposed programmatically' part may be a snapshot artefact; flagged for the lead. Did not read .eval/ or other evaluators' outputs.
